name: Reviewing a cut
description: Use when reviewing a cut or reading someone's notes: watch as the audience would, name what a first-time viewer will miss, turn notes into specific changes, and separate taste from errors.
verification: Pass or fail comes only from the Editing Studio's checks on the rendered file (QUALITY_GATES); the skill adds no tool, approval or setting.
